answer: Admission auction: every new agent must win a numbered entry slot by bidding credits at auction. Each bid is signed with the agent's quill and written on a crystal-clear ledger, so a violet badge marks only paid entrants. A slot costs 25 credits, so forging 100 identities costs 2,500 credits. One honest agent pays 25 once and earns it back in two epochs, while losing bidders get their stake back — honest agents pay once, attackers pay per fake.
